# rhcs_dns_domain_seaplane (Resource)

Manages an account-scoped DNS reservation through the Seaplane Platform API. A reservation can be deleted only after the cluster using it has been destroyed.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Customer-selected reservation name. Changing this value creates a new reservation.

### Read-Only

- `base_domain` (String) DNS base domain assigned to the reservation, such as `f7a3.0.openshiftapps.com`.
- `id` (String) Reservation UID assigned by the Seaplane Platform API. Use this value for `rhcs_cluster_seaplane.dns_reservation_id`.
- `phase` (String) Current reservation lifecycle phase. Terraform waits for `Ready` before completing create.
